submission.natural_language_explanation: L1-H8 is a first-token (attention-sink) reader: every token attends back to position 0, most exclusively at position 1, so excluding the always-active first token its strength peaks on the second token — whether that token continues the first word ('Wh'+'ipl') or starts the next word ('high'+'pressure') — and decays steadily with distance from the start; the peak level is set mostly by the identity of the first token, barely by the second.
